records.title: Access exception GX-501 (fictional)
records.text: On 2026-05-04, Kofi Mensah, head of IT operations, granted Lindgate Analytics read access to the sales reporting database. The access is subject to multi-factor authentication. The vendor assessment VA-501 scored Lindgate against the 12-point supplier checklist and closed both low findings. The exception was granted under the supplier access standard, section 4.

sources.text: Section 4. The head of IT operations may approve read access for a supplier for up to 90 days. Multi-factor authentication is required for all supplier access.
